command_cpu_observations.scope: Timed commands only. Approximate command windows use log final-write mtime minus measured duration; logs are written immediately after completion. Two-second telemetry intervals and short-lived process exits limit attribution. Overlapping intervals are clipped to their chronological union. Same-UID versus other-UID CPU is process ownership, not user-mode versus kernel-mode time. This audit describes overlap and does not alter sample acceptance.
